spec.description: Health of ArgoCD itself: resources, throttling, controller queues and backlog, repo-server and managed objects.

spec.title: Queue depth
spec.description: Items waiting per controller queue: refresh, sync and ApplicationSet.

spec.title: Queue wait time (p95)
spec.description: Time an item waits before a worker picks it up. Rising wait with a stable load means the controller is saturated.

spec.title: Repo-server pending requests
spec.description: Manifest generation requests waiting on the repo-server, per repository.

spec.title: Reconcile duration (p95)
spec.description: Time to refresh one application, per destination cluster.

spec.title: CPU per component
spec.description: CPU of the busiest replica of each component; dashed lines are the requests.

spec.expr: max by (container) (sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="argocd", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Memory per component
spec.description: Memory of the largest replica of each component; dashed lines are the limits.

spec.expr: max by (container) (sum by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace="argocd", container!="", container!="POD"}))

spec.title: Throttled by ArgoCD's own rate limiter (p99)
spec.description: Time the controller's requests to each managed cluster wait in its client-side QPS/burst limiter.

spec.title: Throttled by managed clusters (HTTP 429)
spec.description: Requests from ArgoCD rejected by a managed cluster's API server as too many requests.

spec.title: Cached objects
spec.description: Kubernetes objects held in the controller cache across all managed clusters.

spec.title: Out of sync apps
spec.description: Applications whose sync status is not Synced.

spec.title: Restarts (24h)
spec.description: ArgoCD container restarts over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: OOM kills (24h)
spec.description: ArgoCD containers killed for running out of memory over the last 24 hours.

spec.title: Applications per controller shard
spec.description: Applications handled by each application-controller replica.

spec.title: Cached objects per cluster
spec.description: Kubernetes objects cached per managed cluster: what drives controller memory.

spec.title: ArgoCD / Operational
